message.qbotics.uplink.on: Uplink: computers on this cable network can reach the internet (import requests).
message.qbotics.uplink.off: Uplink: the internet is switched off on this server.
screen.qbotics.qbot.log_hint: Drag to select lines - Ctrl+C copies (all, with none selected)
screen.qbotics.qbot.ended.no_program: No program: install one with a Programmer
item.qbotics.transport_upgrade.tooltip: Carries items, fluid and energy to other networks (both ends need one)
item.qbotics.sense_upgrade.tooltip: A Qbot senses blocks up to 4 away in every direction
item.qbotics.transport_upgrade.fits: Fits an antenna or a Qbot (right-click it)
item.qbotics.chunk_loader_upgrade.fits: Fits an antenna, a Qbot or a Server (right-click it)
item.qbotics.netherite_upgrade.tooltip: With an empty hand, a Qbot digs as netherite with silk touch; broken, it doesn't burn
screen.qbotics.antenna.status.over_limit: Paused: owner has too many loaders
screen.qbotics.antenna.status.no_owner: No owner: placed by a machine
screen.qbotics.web.hint: Click to use it, scroll the wheel to scroll. Esc closes.
screen.qbotics.web.typing: Typing: Enter sends it, Esc leaves the field.
screen.qbotics.close_up_hint: Click to touch; drag a slider. Esc closes.
item.qbotics.hard_drive.blank: Blank, %s MB. Put it in a Drive Bay to use it.
item.qbotics.hard_drive.used: Holds files (%s MB). In a Drive Bay, computers on its network see them in /net.
screen.qbotics.socket_fluid_help: Click with a bucket of a fluid to keep this tank for it; with an empty hand to let it take any.
screen.qbotics.bucket_help: A full bucket put here empties into the tank above; an empty one fills from it.
screen.qbotics.charge_help: A battery put here is charged from this store.
screen.qbotics.drain_help: A battery put here is drained into this store.
screen.qbotics.box.hint: Each face's offset from the sensor, in blocks
screen.qbotics.sensor.not_yours: Only its owner can change its size.
screen.qbotics.xp.holds: Holds %s points: enough to take a new player to level %s
screen.qbotics.xp.locked: This is locked: you can't store or take here
screen.qbotics.xp.lock.private: Lock: only the owner (click to change)
screen.qbotics.xp.lock.team: Lock: the owner's team (click to change)
screen.qbotics.xp.lock.public: Lock: open to everyone (click to change)
tooltip.qbotics.probe.name: Name in programs: %s
tooltip.qbotics.probe.hint: Ctrl+C copies the name. Hold Shift for its tags and data.
message.qbotics.probe_mode.0: Probe: Labels - right-click a device for its name and addresses. Sneak + scroll changes mode.
message.qbotics.probe_mode.1: Probe: Slots - open a chest, furnace or machine to see its slot numbers. Sneak + scroll changes mode.
message.qbotics.probe_mode.2: Probe: Tunnels - right-click a bus, then another, to tunnel between them. Sneak + right-click a tunnelled bus sets which way it pulls. Sneak + scroll changes mode.
message.qbotics.tunnel.not_bus: Tunnels join Serial Buses: right-click the plate of a bus.
message.qbotics.tunnel.chosen: Tunnel from %s: right-click the bus at the other end (or this one again to cancel).
message.qbotics.tunnel.linked: %s tunnels to %s. Right-click another bus to re-route it, or this one again to close it.
message.qbotics.tunnel.closed: Tunnel closed at %s and its other end.
message.qbotics.tunnel.pull: Tunnel pulls from %s to %s. Sneak + right-click again to change it.
message.qbotics.tunnel.pull_off: Tunnel between %s and %s no longer pulls: it passes on what is pushed in or pulled out.
message.qbotics.tunnel.no_tunnel: %s is not in a tunnel: right-click it, then another bus, to open one.
message.qbotics.probe_no_slots: That block has no screen to show slots on.
item.qbotics.tablet.tip: Right-click: its screen. Sneak + right-click an antenna: pair with (or unpair from) its network.
message.qbotics.tablet.not_router: That antenna isn't its network's router: pair with the network's first antenna.
message.qbotics.tablet.full: A tablet can be paired with %s networks at most. Unpair one first.
screen.qbotics.tablet.unpaired: Not paired with anything. Sneak and right-click a network's antenna, or a Qbot, with the tablet.
item.qbotics.laptop.tip: Right-click: your laptop. Sneak + right-click: its drives. On a computer or Qbot of yours: connect to it.
message.qbotics.laptop.not_yours: That isn't yours to connect to. ssh in instead, if its owner allows.
message.qbotics.laptop.disabled: Laptops are switched off on this server.
message.qbotics.probe_nothing: That isn't a network device. Aim at a computer, an interface, an antenna or a plate.
screen.qbotics.probe.title: This is: %s
screen.qbotics.probe.hint: Click a line to copy it, then paste it into your program with Ctrl+V
screen.qbotics.probe.name: Name (letters, digits, _ - .)
message.qbotics.plate_taken: That side of the cable already carries a plate.
message.qbotics.plate_needs_cable: A plate goes on a cable: you need a cable in your inventory.
advancements.qbotics.lessons.root.title: Qbotics Lessons
advancements.qbotics.lessons.root.descri: Programs that run your base, one lesson at a time. On a computer, type git clone lessons to begin
advancements.qbotics.lessons.01_hello.de: Make a program print "hello world". The lesson: cd /lessons/01_hello
Find a named device on your computer's network from a program. The lesson: cd /lessons/02_network
advancements.qbotics.lessons.03_first_mo: Move items from one chest to another with a program. The lesson: cd /lessons/03_first_move
Sort: move items to a list of chests, or through a bus with a filter. The lesson: cd /lessons/04_sorting
advancements.qbotics.lessons.05_events.d: Have a program wait for a change, a signal or a click, and act on it. The lesson: cd /lessons/05_events
advancements.qbotics.lessons.06_redstone: Send a redstone signal from a Logic Pin, and react to one with on_pin. The lesson: cd /lessons/06_redstone
advancements.qbotics.lessons.07_smelting: Take what a furnace has smelted with a program. The lesson: cd /lessons/07_smelting
advancements.qbotics.lessons.08_crafting: Craft at a crafting table with a Recipe. The lesson: cd /lessons/08_crafting
advancements.qbotics.lessons.09_workstat: Take what a stonecutter, smithing table, grindstone, loom or anvil made. The lesson: cd /lessons/09_workstations
Move items into or out of a storage of four or more chests. The lesson: cd /lessons/10_storage
Open a Text Monitor from a program and write on it. The lesson: cd /lessons/11_monitor
advancements.qbotics.lessons.12_panel.de: Have a program react to a player pressing a Control Panel's widget. The lesson: cd /lessons/12_panel
advancements.qbotics.lessons.13_web.desc: Have a program react to a player clicking or typing on a Web Panel's page. The lesson: cd /lessons/13_web
advancements.qbotics.lessons.14_tablet.t: In the Palm of Your Hand
advancements.qbotics.lessons.14_tablet.d: Have a program react to a player using its page on a Tablet. The lesson: cd /lessons/14_tablet
advancements.qbotics.lessons.15_always_o: Keep a program started by startup.sh or startup.py running for a whole game day. The lesson: cd /lessons/15_always_on
advancements.qbotics.lessons.16_radio.de: Through antennas, send a message to another computer and work a device on another network. The lesson: cd /lessons/16_radio
Keep a service running on a Server for a whole game day. The lesson: cd /lessons/17_service
advancements.qbotics.lessons.18_farmer.d: Harvest and replant a crop with a Block Sensor, or tend an animal with an Entity Sensor. The lesson: cd /lessons/18_farmer
advancements.qbotics.lessons.19_qbot.des: Have a Qbot's own program move it and dig. The lesson: cd /lessons/19_qbot
Craft from a storage of eight or more chests, sort what arrives, show it on a display, and run it unattended. The lesson: cd /lessons/20_factory
